faqs.question: Do giveaways actually help?
faqs.answer: Done right — with mechanics that attract your target audience, not just prize-hunters — they boost reach, followers, and engagement meaningfully.

faqs.question: Do you handle winner selection and rules?
faqs.answer: Yes — we set clear, compliant terms, moderate entries, and select winners fairly and transparently.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
